name: pulselocal-ai
description: PulseLocal AI — Lead Catcher, Smart Booking & Google Review Booster for local service businesses

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c teal,magenta "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix server --omit=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
